GSAP 3.14.2 is copied from the official npm distribution:
https://registry.npmjs.org/gsap/-/gsap-3.14.2.tgz

The distribution contains the copyright notice at the start of gsap.min.js.
Its package metadata links to https://gsap.com/standard-license/.
That official license page is preserved locally as GSAP-LICENSE.html.

Hyperframes registry sources used by this composition:

- caption-clip-wipe: same-position text clipping mechanism.
- app-showcase: stage and screen wrappers, adapted to two actual native app screenshots.

All render dependencies are local. This file does not grant rights to third-party assets.
